mechanics.claim: Blood Frenzy's attack-based bonus damage, on-hit missing-health damage, AoE splash and life-on-hit healing all apply while Hematomania is active, since Briar gains all effects of Blood Frenzy.

During Hematomania Briar's attacks and movement are uncontrollable and she is forced to prioritize the marked target, which matters for who takes the damage in a dummy fight but is otherwise not a damage-scaling change.
Casting E (Chilling Scream) interrupts/ends the frenzy early, cutting off further Blood-Frenzy-derived damage.
R is disabled while already in Hematomania, so it cannot be recast to refresh the effect.
Cooldown starts on cast, not on hit or on Hematomania ending.
The explosion deals its magic damage only once on arrival, to the marked target and nearby enemies.
mechanics.quote: she creates an explosion around the marked target that deals {{as|magic damage}} to them and nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: Hematomania lasts until the mark is removed by any means (including either champion's death), not for a fixed duration.
mechanics.quote: ''Hematomania'' lasts until the mark is dispelled by any means, including '''Briar's''' or the target's death.
